text: Analyze your emotional reactions as a source of information. A strong emotion—aggression, resentment, envy—is a signal that some value important to you has been touched or an unmet need. Instead of suppressing or splashing out the emotion, treat it with attention and ask yourself: “What is it signaling to me? What in me is it protecting?” In this way you turn destructive energy into fuel for self-knowledge. Believe me, with such an approach the psyche will soon be reformatted and negative emotions will visit you much less often. Perhaps because you have used up all that fuel which is on the surface.
